info.name: Family Hub API
info.description:
Family Hub API, generated from apps/api/openapi.json. Do not edit by hand:
run `pnpm -F api openapi:generate` after any API change.

Set these environment variables before sending requests:
- `userToken`: a parent or adult sign-in token. Sign in to the web app, then
  copy `access_token` from the `sb-...-auth-token` entry in the browser storage.
- `tenantSlug`: the family web address, e.g. `khan-family`.
- `kidToken`: filled automatically by "Exchange a kid PIN" (needs `kidMemberId`
  and `kidPin`).
- `*Id` variables: the id of the record a request acts on.

item.name: admin
IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes the caller's family and all its data; admin-only
Download the family's full data as one JSON file (GDPR data portability); admin-only
The family's app_settings map, plus its currency under the `currency` key
Upsert one setting; admin-only. `currency` writes tenants.currency, not app_settings
assignments
List the family's assignments (homework/chores); any member

request.description: Ordered by due date ascending (undated last), then created_at: open/overdue assignments sit on top, undated ones trail behind.

item.name: Create an assignment; admin/adult only
Replace an assignment's title/notes/dueDate/assignee; admin/adult only

request.description: Completion state (done/doneAt) is owned by PATCH and left untouched here, so editing a done assignment keeps it done.

item.name: Toggle an assignment done/not-done; admin/adult only

request.description: `done: true` stamps doneAt to now; `false` clears it.

item.name: auth
Exchange a kid PIN for a kid session token
calendar
The family calendar subscribe URL (creates the feed key on first call)
Regenerate the calendar feed key (admin-only); invalidates old subscriptions
dashboard
Everything the Today/Dashboard tab renders, in one round-trip

request.description: Bundles the roster, per-kid habit progress, weekly streaks, pending-task counts, a Today's Snapshot stat row, savings goals, and a merged Recent Activity feed (tasks, meals, calendar activities, habit stickers and approved reward redemptions, newest 5) instead of fanning out to five separate endpoints.

item.name: events
The family's calendar activities for a week (?weekStart=YYYY-MM-DD)

query.description: Monday of the week to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD)

item.name: Create a calendar activity; admin/adult only

request.description: Optional recurrenceDays (weekdays 0=Sun..6=Sat) + recurrenceEndDate turn it into a weekly-repeating series anchored on `date`. No occurrence rows are stored: GET expands the series on read.

item.name: Replace an event (full update); admin/adult only

request.description: For a recurring series this edits the WHOLE series (start date, weekdays, end date, and all other fields): not a single occurrence. Single-occurrence editing is a follow-up.

item.name: Delete an event; admin/adult only
feedback
Submit a beta survey response

request.description: Authenticated users submit product feedback. All fields are optional but at least one must be present.

item.name: habits
A member's habits + this week's stickers + spendable balance

query.description: UUID of the member whose habits/stickers to fetch
A specific week id to view (FHS-293 navigation); defaults to, and falls back to, the current open week if not found

item.name: Create a habit for a member; admin-only
Update a habit (name/icon/color/boost/skipPenaltyMinor); admin-only
Delete a habit (its stickers cascade); admin-only

request.description: memberId in the body scopes the delete, so a caller cannot delete another child’s habit.

item.name: Place a typed sticker on a habit day for a week

request.description: Any grown-up, or the member themself. Editing a past day, or any day in a finalized week, is admin-only (FHS-335). stickerValue is derived from the habit’s boost, not the request.

item.name: Remove a sticker from a habit day for a week

request.description: Any grown-up, or the member themself. Removing a past day, or any day in a finalized week, is admin-only (FHS-335).

item.name: invitations
Invite someone to the family; admin or adult only

request.description: role is one of admin | adult | teen | guest (default adult). Granting 'admin' requires the caller to already be an admin (403 otherwise): FHS-486 / ADR 0019.

item.name: Resend a still-pending invitation email; admin or adult only

request.description: Re-fires the Supabase invite email (e.g. a typo'd address, or the email got lost). 404 if the invitation is not in this tenant; 409 if it is no longer pending (already accepted/expired).

item.name: Claim invites addressed to the caller's own email

request.description: Called right after sign-in when the caller has no membership yet. For each matching pending invitation, links an unclaimed seat (or creates one, for a members-page invite with no pre-created seat) to the caller and flips the invitation to accepted. No tenant header required: the invitation rows carry the tenant scope.

item.name: journal
A member's journal entry for one day, plus that day's quote index; the member themself, or an admin/adult

query.description: UUID of the member whose journal is being read
The calendar day to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD, must be a real date)

item.name: Create or update a member's journal entry for one day (upsert); the member themself, or an admin/adult

request.description: quoteIndex is computed server-side from entryDate: the caller cannot set it. Keyed on (tenantId, memberId, entryDate), so a repeat call for the same day overwrites rather than duplicates.

item.name: Static journal reference data: quotes, creativity prompts, and moods

request.description: No member scope: the same content for every member in the signed-in family.

item.name: me
The signed-in user + their families
meals
The family's weekly meal plan (every planned meal slot)
Upsert or clear one meal-plan cell (dayOfWeek + slot [+ member]); admin/adult only

request.description: An empty/whitespace-only name deletes that cell instead of saving it, so the UI can clear a slot with the same endpoint. A (day, slot) can hold one whole-family meal (memberId: null) plus one per member, keyed on both.

item.name: members
List family members
Add a family member seat (child, teen, or adult); admin only

request.description: No login is created: this is a direct roster insert, not an invite.

item.name: Rename a member and/or toggle their admin↔adult role; admin only

request.description: role may only move between admin and adult (kid roles are fixed at creation). The target must already be adult/admin to be touched; an admin can't demote themselves, and the last remaining admin can never be demoted or removed. 400 with a reason when a guard blocks the change; 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

item.name: Remove a member from the family; admin only

request.description: Their content (tasks, habits, etc.) cascades with them. The last remaining admin can never be removed. 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

item.name: Start changing a grown-up member's sign-in email; admin-only

request.description: Emails a one-time confirm link to the NEW address, plus a best-effort heads-up notice to the OLD address (never blocks this response). The old address keeps working until the link is clicked. 400 NO_LOGIN_EMAIL if the target has no linked login; 409 if the new email already belongs to a Family Hub account, or if a concurrent request for the same member won the race.

item.name: Cancel the caller's own pending sign-in email change; self-serve only

request.description: 403 if the target id is not the caller's own member row. Always 200, even if there was nothing pending.

item.name: Set a kid member's 4-digit login PIN; admin or adult only

request.description: The target must have role child or teen (403 PIN_TARGET_INELIGIBLE otherwise). Setting a PIN also flips isChild on. Clears any existing lockout from prior wrong attempts.

item.name: Clear a kid member's login PIN; admin or adult only

request.description: Also flips isChild off and clears any existing lockout bucket.

item.name: Apply a pending email change from the emailed confirm link

request.description: PUBLIC: the recipient may not be signed in. The token is the credential (its SHA-256 hash is matched server-side); single-use and expires 24h after the admin started the change. Sends a best-effort completion notice to the OLD address on success (never blocks this response). The web ConfirmEmail screen requires an explicit click before calling this: it never auto-fires on page load, so an email link-scanner prefetch cannot burn the token.

onboarding
Finish the onboarding wizard; admin only

request.description: Atomically sets tenant timezone/currency, renames the caller to yourName (if given), inserts one members row per wizard-added member, marks onboarding_completed, seeds starter habits/rewards, then best-effort emails an invite to each adult member that carried an email. Idempotent: a repeat call after completion returns the current tenant unchanged with membersAdded: 0, invitesSent: 0.

public
Public ICS calendar feed for one family, for Google/Apple/Outlook (signed token = credential, no sign-in)

request.description: Parses and verifies the signed token before touching any event row; every failure (bad signature, rotated-out key, unknown tenant) returns the same bare 404, so the endpoint never reveals which families exist. Only includes events from the last 90 days onward; future events are unbounded.

request.description: Unauthenticated visitors submit product feedback from the public homepage. All fields optional but at least one survey field (not just name/email) must be present.

Create a task for myself; any member

request.description: Always owned by the caller: memberId comes from the session, never the body.

item.name: Replace one of my own tasks' title/dueDate; any member

request.description: Owner-scoped, same WHERE as PATCH/DELETE. memberId and completion state (doneAt) are not editable here.

item.name: Tick/untick one of my own tasks; any member

request.description: Owner-scoped: a member can only mutate their own tasks. 404 covers both wrong-owner and not-found, by design, so a probe can't enumerate another member's task ids.
